description: Read price data other workspaces have shared in the data exchange: the newest data points, optionally for one vertical, with how many contributors back each and how fresh it is. Each query spends 5 tokens; below 5 tokens it is refused with your balance, and you earn tokens with contribute_price_data. Page with limit and offset. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

limit.description: How many to return. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: How many to skip, for the next page.

vertical.description: Only data points in this vertical.

name: query_jale_pool
